question: Which tier of the Panchayati Raj system in India is involved in governing the entire district?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Zila Parishad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Zila Parishad** is the apex or third tier in the **Panchayati Raj system** in India.
 
• It is responsible for governing the entire **district level administration.**
 
• The Zila Parishad acts as the coordinating body between the **Gram Panchayats** and the **Block Samitis.**
 
• It oversees **developmental activities** such as health, education, agriculture, irrigation, and rural development at the district level.
 
• The members of Zila Parishad are elected representatives from the constituencies in the district.<
